input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: The first dev report scored cut gaps against the best of the designs SPMe could run, hiding the 7 pools where SPMe fails on the DFN-best design; caught before writing up, re-scored against the whole pool, no verdict changed (logged as an amendment in LOG.md).

The first predictor sweep was restarted once (after ~700 designs) to record the end-of-charge stoichiometry and OCP grid the self-limited model needed; the restart happened before the plan was written.

doc_friction.issue: pyenv.py returned /usr/bin/python3.13 with pybamm already importable; the pip install note led me to start a background install that was not needed (minor).

Each milestone imports the previous one's run.py through a chain (plating -> frontcut -> latefade -> halving -> gate ...); finding where current mapping, dev_conditions and union_screen live took several reads. A shared module would save the next run time.

deviations.why: Mission prefers testing on fresh data; the predictor failed its pre-registered tests on 24 committed conditions it had not been read on, so a fresh 64-design DFN bench (about 45 minutes) would only have re-measured a refuted method.
deviations.did: Pre-registered H100 to H103 on the unseen committed conditions and ran no fresh DFN bench.
deviations.result: Clear negative result with a mechanism (lithium-to-energy ratio varies about twofold within a pool) and a concrete next step; compute went to the 2,324-design sweep instead.

notes: Programme cell-fidelity milestone 5q (draw via pick_track.py). 2,324 two-cycle SPMe runs (SEI + plating) on every committed design of 36 conditions, about 35 min on 4 cores. H100-H103 all refuted on the 24 unseen conditions: p2 vs fade median Spearman 0.03; limited < w2 on 20 of 24; keep-half cut misses up to 6.1% and costs 0.92-1.45x the union screen; SPMe failed on 456 designs (the DFN best on 7 pools). Checks run here: pytest research/cell-fidelity/tests (157 passed), research/_homepage/build.py ok, check_md_links ok, programme_check ok, check_post_frontmatter ok, post_similarity 0 pairs, research_live_links --write (0 updated).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a battery-modelling researcher scripting 2,324 PyBaMM runs, a plating-model derivation, pre-registration and write-up: about two days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
